reason: I've paid for and cancelled this exact kind of app two or three times, and I'm back to Apple Notes because it costs nothing and never nags me. The done/push/shrink/drop prompt sounds nice, but the page never says it works with my work Google or Outlook calendar, and without that it's useless to me.
objection: My meetings live on a work calendar I don't control. If Moduo doesn't sync both ways with it, my blocks and my real meetings end up on two calendars and the whole plan falls apart, which is exactly why I quit the last ones.
would_change_my_mind: A clear, specific promise that it syncs two-way with Google and Outlook work calendars, which I could check in the no-card trial before paying anything.
